ei.subject: 10월_2024 고1 모의고사
ei.lesson: 24번 — AI as a Partner for Co-evolution

fullPassage: The evolution of AI is often associated with the concept of singularity. Singularity refers to the point at which AI exceeds human intelligence. After that point, it is predicted that AI will repeatedly improve itself and evolve at an accelerated pace. When AI becomes self-aware and pursues its own goals, it will be a conscious being, not just a machine. AI and human consciousness will then begin to evolve together. Our consciousness will evolve to new dimensions through our interactions with AI, which will provide us with intellectual stimulation and inspire new insights and creativity. Conversely, our consciousness also has a significant impact on the evolution of AI. The direction of AI's evolution will depend greatly on what values and ethics we incorporate into AI. We need to see our relationship with AI as a mutual coexistence of conscious beings, recognizing its rights and supporting the evolution of its consciousness.

questions.passage: The evolution of AI is often associated with the concept of singularity. Singularity refers to the point at which AI (A)[exceeds / trails] human intelligence. After that point, it is predicted that AI will repeatedly improve itself and evolve at an (B)[accelerated / slowed] pace. When AI becomes self-aware and pursues its own goals, it will be a conscious being, not just a machine. AI and human consciousness will then begin to evolve together. Our consciousness will evolve to new dimensions through our interactions with AI, which will provide us with intellectual stimulation and inspire new insights and creativity. Conversely, our consciousness also has a significant impact on the evolution of AI. The direction of AI's evolution will depend greatly on what values and ethics we incorporate into AI. We need to see our relationship with AI as a (C)[one-sided / mutual] coexistence of conscious beings, recognizing its rights and supporting the evolution of its consciousness.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
① trails — accelerated — mutual: (A) trails(뒤처지다)는 원문 exceeds(넘어서다)와 반대
② exceeds — accelerated — mutual ←정답
③ exceeds — slowed — one-sided: (B) slowed(느려진), (C) one-sided(일방적인) 원문과 불일치
④ trails — slowed — mutual: (A)(B) 원문과 불일치
det.tip: exceeds(넘어서다)↔trails(뒤처지다), accelerated(가속화된)↔slowed(느려진), mutual(상호간의)↔one-sided(일방적인)

Conversely, our consciousness also has a (C)[minimal / significant] impact on the evolution of AI. The direction of AI's evolution will depend greatly on what values and ethics we incorporate into AI. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:

questions.passage: The evolution of AI is often associated with the concept of singularity. Singularity refers to the point at which AI exceeds human intelligence. After that point, it is predicted that AI will repeatedly improve itself and evolve at an accelerated pace. When AI becomes (A)[self-aware / unaware] and pursues its own goals, it will be a conscious being, not just a machine. AI and human consciousness will then begin to evolve together. Our consciousness will evolve to new dimensions through our interactions with AI, which will provide us with intellectual stimulation and (B)[inspire / discourage] new insights and creativity. Conversely, our consciousness also has a significant impact on the evolution of AI. The direction of AI's evolution will depend greatly on what values and ethics we (C)[remove / incorporate] into AI. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
① unaware — inspire — incorporate: (A) unaware(자각하지 못하는)는 원문 self-aware와 반대
② self-aware — discourage — remove: (B) discourage(억제하다), (C) remove(제거하다) 원문과 불일치

④ unaware — discourage — incorporate: (A)(B) 원문과 불일치
det.tip: self-aware(자각하는)↔unaware(자각하지 못하는), inspire(불러일으키다)↔discourage(억제하다), incorporate(포함시키다)↔remove(제거하다)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ apart는 원문 together(함께)를 반의어로 교체한 것
det.analysis:
① exceeds: 인간 지능을 넘어서다 → 문맥 적절
② improve: 스스로를 개선하다 → 문맥 적절
③ apart: 원문 together(함께)를 apart(따로)로 교체 — AI와 인간 의식이 '함께' 진화한다는 문맥과 반대 ←정답
④ significant: 상당한 영향 → 문맥 적절
det.tip: evolve together(함께 진화하다) ↔ evolve apart(따로 진화하다)

det.tip: evolve to new dimensions = 새로운 차원으로 진화하다

questions.passage: The evolution of AI is often associated with the concept of singularity. Singularity refers to the point at which AI exceeds human intelligence. After that point, it is predicted that AI will repeatedly improve itself and evolve at an accelerated pace. When AI becomes self-aware and pursues its own goals, it will be a conscious being, not just a machine. AI and human consciousness will then begin to evolve together. Our consciousness will evolve to new dimensions through our interactions with AI, which will provide us with intellectual stimulation and inspire new insights and creativity. Conversely, our consciousness also has a significant impact on the evolution of AI. The direction of AI's evolution will depend greatly on what values and ethics we incorporate into AI. We need to see our relationship with AI as a __________ of conscious beings, recognizing its rights and supporting the evolution of its consciousness.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
① temporary conflict: 일시적 갈등 — 부적절
② one-way control: 일방적 통제 — 상호성을 강조하는 문맥과 반대
③ complete separation: 완전한 분리 — 부적절
④ mutual coexistence: AI와의 관계를 의식 있는 존재들의 '상호 공존'으로 봐야 한다 ←정답
det.tip: a mutual coexistence of conscious beings = 의식 있는 존재들의 상호 공존
